items.title: Surprise nonfarm payrolls print sends Bitcoin back below 80K
items.summary: The US economy added far more jobs than expected in August, pressuring Bitcoin lower as traders repriced the odds of a Federal Reserve rate cut this month.

items.title: August Payrolls Knock Bitcoin Off $81,000
items.summary: Bitcoin fell $1,430 in the five minutes after the Bureau of Labor Statistics reported 162,000 August jobs, five times the average of the prior year.

items.title: President Trump says he wants Hyperliquid to enter the US — here’s how it could happen
